contentEn:
A standard single-bathroom renovation in Richmond typically costs $20,000 to $28,000 in 2026, depending on size, fixture count, and material grade. A dual-bathroom or master-bath upgrade runs $33,000 to $42,000 or more. Reno Stars has completed bathroom projects in Richmond including a daughter's bath with custom gray tile and a dual bathroom with a powder room, giving us accurate local pricing data to share.

Richmond costs align closely with neighbouring Metro Vancouver cities. Use this table as a baseline for budgeting your project.

These figures cover labour and materials where stated. Exact quotes depend on your specific layout, chosen fixtures, and whether plumbing reconfiguration is needed.

What Drives the Cost of a Richmond Bathroom Renovation?

The single biggest variable is the scope of work. A like-for-like fixture replacement — swapping a vanity, toilet, and tub for updated models in the same positions — sits at the lower end. Moving drains, adding a second sink, or enlarging the footprint pushes cost significantly because it requires a licensed plumber and often a permit.

  • Bathroom size: A 35–45 sq ft standard bath falls in the $20,000–$28,000 range. A 60–80 sq ft master bath typically lands at $33,000–$42,000.
  • Fixture count: Adding a second toilet (powder room), a double vanity, or a curbless walk-in shower each adds $3,000–$8,000 to the project.
  • Material grade: Standard porcelain tile runs $3–$8 per sq ft installed. Imported natural stone or large-format porcelain panels run $12–$25 per sq ft. For a 45 sq ft bathroom, tile alone can swing $400 to $1,800 depending on selection.
  • Plumbing reconfiguration: Keeping all drains in their existing positions saves $2,000–$5,000 versus moving them, since concrete breaking and drain rerouting require a licensed plumber.

What Does a Richmond Bathroom Renovation Actually Look Like?

Reno Stars completed a Richmond daughter's bathroom renovation featuring custom gray ceramic wall tile, a frameless glass shower enclosure, and a floating vanity. The project scope included replacing all plumbing fixtures, installing new LED lighting, and refinishing the floor with large-format porcelain. Every step was managed by a dedicated site supervisor who served as the homeowner's daily point of contact.

Another Richmond project involved a dual-bathroom renovation that combined a main bath and a separate powder room. The scope covered demo through to final cleanup, with the powder room completed in a separate phase to minimise disruption to the household during construction.

Richmond Strata Considerations for Condo Renovations

Many Richmond residents live in strata condominiums, which adds a layer of approvals before work can begin. The strata council must approve renovation permits in advance, and this process typically adds two to four weeks to project startup. Strata rules commonly restrict work hours to Monday through Saturday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm, and may require contractor insurance certificates to be submitted before commencement.

Reno Stars has managed bathroom and whole-home renovations in Richmond strata buildings including The Ferride, Brittanys, and Peninsula Estates. Our site supervisor coordinates directly with strata management so homeowners do not need to navigate the approval process alone.

Permits for a Richmond Bathroom Renovation

For a like-for-like fixture replacement in Richmond, a permit may not be required. However, if the scope includes moving plumbing, altering electrical circuits, or removing or adding walls, a building permit from the City of Richmond is required. The permit fee for a standard bathroom alteration typically ranges from $200 to $600 depending on the declared construction value.

Reno Stars handles the permit application process as part of our standard project management. We submit the permit package, coordinate inspections, and ensure all work passes final inspection before declaring the project complete.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average cost of a bathroom renovation in Richmond BC?

A standard single-bathroom renovation in Richmond costs $20,000 to $28,000 in 2026. A master bath or dual-bathroom project typically runs $33,000 to $42,000 depending on scope and material selections. These figures are based on actual Reno Stars project data from completed Richmond renovations.

How long does a bathroom renovation take in Richmond?

A single-bathroom renovation in Richmond typically takes 5 to 7 weeks from demolition to final inspection. A dual-bathroom or master-bath renovation extends to 7 to 10 weeks. Condo projects add 2 to 4 weeks for strata approval before construction begins.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Richmond?

You need a City of Richmond building permit if the renovation involves moving plumbing fixtures, altering electrical wiring, or modifying walls. A like-for-like fixture swap (replacing a toilet, vanity, or tub in the same positions) typically does not require a permit. Reno Stars handles the permit application and inspection coordination for every project that requires one.

What is the most expensive part of a bathroom renovation?

Plumbing reconfiguration is typically the most expensive single line item, potentially adding $2,000 to $5,000 if drains need to be moved. Tiling and waterproofing, especially in a curbless shower design, also represents a significant portion of the budget at $3,000 to $8,000 depending on material choice and bathroom size.

Can Reno Stars work in a strata building in Richmond?

Yes. Reno Stars has completed multiple bathroom and whole-home renovations in Richmond strata buildings. We submit all required documentation to the strata management company, coordinate work schedules around building rules, and carry the required insurance coverage.

影响列治文浴室装修价格的因素

  • 浴室面积：35至45平方尺的标准浴室费用在$20,000至$28,000。60至80平方尺的主卧浴室通常在$33,000至$42,000。
  • 设施数量：加装第二个马桶（化妆间）、双洗手台或无障碍步入式淋浴间，每个项目增加$3,000至$8,000。
  • 材料等级：标准瓷砖安装费用为每平方尺$3至$8。进口天然石材或大规格瓷砖板为每平方尺$12至$25。以45平方尺浴室为例，瓷砖费用差异可达$400至$1,800。
  • 管道改位：保持所有排水管位置不变可节省$2,000至$5,000，因为移动排水管需要破拆混凝土并由持牌水管工施工。

常见问题

2026年列治文标准单浴室装修费用为$20,000至$28,000。主卧浴室或双浴室装修通常在$33,000至$42,000之间，具体取决于工程范围和材料选择。以上数据基于聚星装修已完成的列治文实际装修项目。
